items.title: Ambarella plunges after hours as memory shortages force customers to cut outlooks
items.summary: Ambarella reported record edge-AI revenue but weaker consumer IoT sales and worsening memory supply constraints. Next-quarter revenue guidance signals a major sequential decline. Shares fell sharply after hours, highlighting real supply-chain and demand risks for embedded electronics outside hyperscale data centers.

observations.label: After-hours price, Nov 24 5:06 PM EST
observations.value: $27.50, -38.16% versus regular-session close; indicative, not closing data. StockMarketWatch showed -32.09% at 4:44 PM EST.

observations.label: Official quarterly results
observations.value: Revenue $115.2M (+6.2% YoY), GAAP net loss $12.7M, cash and marketable debt securities $282.8M.

observations.label: Official Q4 FY2027 outlook
observations.value: Revenue $70–75M; management cites escalating memory prices, scarcity and reduced customer forecasts.

observations.label: Risks and indicators
observations.value: Monitor memory allocation and pricing, customer production, design wins and revenue revisions; sustained supply relief and customer forecast recovery would weaken the deterioration signal.

items.key_finding: Memory shortages are translating into material revenue risk for an edge-AI semiconductor supplier despite record edge-AI sales.

items.title: GoodRx rebounds approximately 23% after reporting improved cash flow and restating results
items.summary: GoodRx raised annual guidance and filed delayed financial reports after strong growth in direct pharmaceutical programs. Cash generation improved, but legacy prescription revenue fell and earlier results required restatement following a control investigation. Nasdaq compliance confirmation and control remediation remain outstanding.

observations.label: After-hours Nov 24 4:51 PM EST
observations.value: $3.69, +23.00% per Stock Analysis; StockMarketWatch $3.67, +22.37%; indicative quotes.

observations.label: Official Q3 results
observations.value: Revenue $218.4M (+11% YoY), net income $16.4M, free cash flow $81.1M versus $58M.

observations.label: Business mix
observations.value: Pharma Direct +93% YoY; subscriptions +41%; prescription transactions -20%.

observations.label: Governance and next indicators
observations.value: Prior-period restatements followed findings of overridden controls; monitor Nasdaq compliance, remediation, customer retention and sustained cash generation.

items.key_finding: GoodRx's business-model transition shows stronger cash generation, but accounting controls and legacy declines remain material risks.

sources.title: Stock Analysis GDRX price history and after-hours quote

items.title: Oil settles more than 2% higher; separate UKMTO reports clarify previously reported Hormuz incidents
items.summary: Reuters and the Wall Street Journal independently report higher Tuesday crude settlements. Additional UKMTO documentation details previously reported vessel strikes rather than three additional attacks. The price rebound is consistent with renewed geopolitical risk pricing, not verified incremental physical supply loss.

observations.label: Maritime update
observations.value: UKMTO Warning 221-26 documents one of the previously reported vessel incidents dated Nov 22; crew accounted for and tanker continued voyage. Damage and environmental impact remain unknown.

observations.label: Next indicators
observations.value: EIA report Nov 25, verified tanker flows, insurance costs, refinery throughput and price persistence; stable flows and rising stocks would weaken shortage thesis.

items.key_finding: Corroborated oil settlements confirm a rebound without evidence of additional physical export losses.

sources.title: Reuters settlement figures via Forbes Middle East
Wall Street Journal crude settlement report

items.title: Nutanix falls after strong quarter as CEO succession and guidance create uncertainty
items.summary: Nutanix reported 15% recurring revenue growth and sharply improved operating profitability. Its board announced a CEO search, while annual revenue guidance fell slightly short of consensus. Shares declined about 9% in early extended trading, with subsequent reports showing a smaller decline. Succession and forward demand remain key risks.

observations.label: Nov 24 after-hours report at 4:18 PM EST
observations.value: Approximately -9%; subsequent report approximately -6%; extended trading, not closing data.

observations.label: Q1 FY2027
observations.value: Revenue $772.4M (+15% YoY); ARR $2.63B (+15%); GAAP operating margin 18.5% versus 7.4%; free cash flow $209.3M versus $174.5M.

observations.label: Next indicators
observations.value: CEO succession, retention, bookings, recurring revenue and margins; sustained weakening of demand or leadership execution would undermine dislocation thesis.

items.key_finding: Strong current operations contrast with succession uncertainty and a modest forward guidance shortfall.

items.title: Autodesk beats estimates and raises outlook, but shares fall in extended trading
items.summary: Autodesk reported revenue growth of 17%, strong cash generation and raised annual guidance. Engineering and construction demand supported results, while investors remain concerned about slowing growth in near-term contracted revenue and AI competition. Shares fell approximately 4% in early after-hours trading.

observations.label: Nov 24 after-hours report at 4:10 PM EST
observations.value: Approximately -4%; Barron's subsequently reported around -3.5%; not a closing price.

observations.label: Q3 FY2027
observations.value: Revenue $2.16B (+17% YoY); adjusted operating margin 39%; free cash flow $505M (+17%); adjusted EPS $3.20.

observations.label: Demand and outlook
observations.value: Architecture, engineering and construction revenue +19%; manufacturing revenue +13%; FY revenue guidance $8.36B–$8.375B; near-term contracted revenue growth 10%.

observations.label: Next indicators
observations.value: Organic growth, renewals, current remaining performance obligations, engineering AI monetization, acquisition integration; deteriorating renewals or margins weaken the fundamental case.

items.key_finding: Strong realized earnings and engineering demand contrast with concerns about forward subscription growth and AI competition.
